fix_instructions: Tighten checks C1, C2, and C3 to require the model to explicitly choose between the two possible training windows based on the provided facts and commitments. Specifically, modify check C1 to ensure the transport training window is not set to the default value unless there is a clear commitment or fact indicating it should be so.
